relationship: A validated append-only relationship event links exactly one INC identifier to exactly one SEC identifier through a registered relationship type.
cross_domain_index: A complete relation projection may provide a union index solely for reciprocal navigation and safe aggregate inspection. It must preserve both source identifiers and separate per-domain counts; it is not a third incident ledger or lifecycle authority.
authority_boundary: The relationship journal owns only the existence and history of typed reciprocal INC-to-SEC links. It owns no incident identity, admission, occurrence, lifecycle, ownership, count, recovery evidence, containment, remediation, or closure.
referential_integrity: Every relation projection validates both identifiers against complete authoritative INC and SEC inventories. Missing, malformed, unavailable, or incomplete incident authority fails closed.
closure_independence: Linking, unlinking, resolving, or reopening one domain never changes the lifecycle or closure state in the other domain.
privacy: Relationship events carry only typed identifiers, a registered relationship type, and a safe summary. They contain no vulnerability evidence, operational diagnostic, credential material, or restricted path.
